name: Dirichlet

args.name: as
args.description: Nonempty list of positive concentration parameters, one per proportion

title: The Dirichlet distribution
description: The Dirichlet distribution produces a list of proportions that sum to 1, with one entry for each concentration parameter in as. The expected proportion for each entry is its concentration divided by sum(as). Multiplying all concentrations by the same factor greater than 1 preserves these expected proportions while reducing variation around them.
